name: La Cavale Blanche Hospital
title: La Cavale Blanche Hospital
overview:
The restructuring and extension of La Cavale Blanche Hospital at Brest University Hospital (CHU de Brest) transforms the existing building to create a more connected, intuitive and welcoming environment for patients, visitors and staff.

The project reorganises the hospital’s technical and clinical core, consolidating and expanding critical care services, the interventional technical platform and operating theatres, while restructuring pharmacy, sterilisation and logistics facilities within a new logistics hub. These interventions are conceived as part of a coordinated transformation focused on improving the overall hospital experience.

At the heart of the building, the existing atrium is extended to the lower levels through a large new opening and staircase. Bringing natural light deep into the technical platform, the intervention creates visual connections between floors and establishes the atrium as a clear point of orientation. A new vertical circulation core on the façade further improves wayfinding and separates staff and logistics flows from patient and visitor routes.

A new entrance hall creates a more accessible arrival from the main forecourt, with reception and admissions immediately visible. Above the existing hospital, a rooftop extension brings medical and surgical critical care together on a single level. Patient rooms benefit from daylight and outward views, while shared family and visitor spaces incorporate planting, natural light and access to terraces, providing a less clinical environment.

At the lower levels, expanded pharmacy and sterilisation facilities are integrated into the hillside, reducing their visual impact and allowing the hospital’s principal clinical functions to remain prominent on arrival.
